title: Accessibility document block
description: Specialized, structured accessibility documentation: keyboard interactions, ARIA attributes, screen reader announcements, focus behaviors, color contrast pairs, and reduced-motion behaviors. Every entry is a verifiable statement of what the entity does (a fact a test or review can confirm). For general documentation guidance (rules about what authors should do, with rationale and a conformance level) use a `guidelines` block (category 'accessibility').

keyboardInteraction.description: A keyboard interaction spec documenting what happens when a specific key or key combination is pressed.

action.description: What happens when this key is pressed (ex: 'Activates the button', 'Moves focus to the next item in the list', 'Closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger').

context.description: Preconditions for this interaction (ex: 'When the menu is open', 'When focus is on the trigger element', 'When the component is not disabled'). When omitted, the interaction applies to all contexts.

ariaAttribute.description: An ARIA attribute used by the entity: what it communicates and when to apply it.

value.description: The expected value or value pattern (ex: 'true | false', 'string', 'assertive | polite').

description.description: What this attribute communicates to assistive technology and when to apply it. Include guidance on dynamic value changes when applicable.

required.description: Whether this attribute is always required on the entity. Defaults to false, meaning the attribute is conditionally required or optional.

colorContrastEntry.description: A foreground/background color pairing the entity uses. Verify pairing contrast ratios with a criterion (verification: automated) by computing the value from live token values. This helps ensure measurement is accurate.

foreground.description: The foreground token name or resolved color value (ex: 'color-text-primary', '#1a1a1a', 'var(--button-text-color)').

background.description: The background token name or resolved color value (ex: 'color-background-default', '#ffffff', 'var(--button-background)').

context.description: Where this foreground/background combination is used (ex: 'Label text on primary button background in light mode', 'Secondary text on card surface').

accessibility.description: Specialized, structured accessibility documentation for an entity. Every field is data: keyboard interactions, ARIA attributes, per-state announcements, per-trigger focus behaviors, color pairings, and per-animation reduced-motion behaviors. Each entry states what the entity does with verification. This block carries no rules for documentation content. General documentation guidance, with rationale and a conformance level, belongs in a `guidelines` block (with a category 'accessibility' value). The two blocks complement each other on the same entity.

kind.description: Identifies this document block as an accessibility spec.

wcagLevel.description: The minimum WCAG conformance level targeted by this entity.

criteria.description: Testable accessibility success criteria for this entity (ex: 'All interactive targets present a hit area of at least 44×44 px'). Each criterion pairs a stable identifier with an objectively verifiable statement. This lets accessibility checks run against the docs and report pass/fail. The structured data below shows how these conditions are met: keyboard interactions, ARIA attributes, contrast pairs.

keyboardInteractions.description: Keyboard interaction specs: what happens when each key or key combination is pressed while the entity has focus.

ariaAttributes.description: ARIA attribute docs. Lists every ARIA attribute the entity uses, what it communicates, and when to apply it.

announcements.description: Screen reader announcements, one entry per state or situation. Name a specific screen reader on an entry when behavior differs between them.

focusBehaviors.description: Focus movement, one entry per trigger: how focus enters, moves within, and leaves the entity. Includes trapping and restoration.

colorContrast.description: The foreground/background color pairings this entity uses, one entry per pairing. Pairs are declarations of intent. Measure them with an automated contrast criterion, not by hand.

reducedMotion.description: Animations and their prefers-reduced-motion behavior, one entry per animation.

announcement.description: What a screen reader announces in one context or state.

context.description: The state or situation being announced (ex: 'default', 'disabled via aria-disabled', 'loading'). Use 'default' for the resting state.

announcement.description: What is announced (ex: '[label], button, dimmed'). Use bracketed placeholders for content that varies.

screenReader.description: The specific screen reader this announcement applies to (ex: 'VoiceOver', 'NVDA', 'JAWS'). When omitted, the announcement applies to all screen readers.

focusBehavior.description: How focus moves at one moment in the entity's lifecycle.

trigger.description: The moment or event (ex: 'default', 'open', 'close'). Use 'default' for normal tab-order participation.

behavior.description: What focus does (ex: 'Moves to the error summary', 'Returns to the trigger element', 'Participates in the normal tab order').

reducedMotionEntry.description: One animation and its behavior under prefers-reduced-motion.

animation.description: The animation or transition (ex: 'loading spinner rotation', 'background-color 100ms transition').

behavior.description: What happens when reduced motion is preferred (ex: 'Replaced with a static ellipsis indicator', 'Transition removed. State changes apply instantly').
